title: gentiana germanica subsp. austriaca
intro: Gentiana germanica subsp. austriaca, commonly known as the Austrian gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Austrian gentian include its potential to treat digestive problems, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin, gentianine, and other iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of stimulating digestion and relieving nausea.
